articles.title: Open USD takes on Tether, Circle with a different stablecoin model that's 'building money'
articles.snippet: The “overwhelming majority” of Open Standard’s equity will be distributed over time to partners based on how much they help grow the stablecoin, CEO Zach Abrams said.

articles.title: Clock's ticking: UK's crypto regulatory application window opens with February deadline
articles.snippet: The five-month application window precedes the new regulatory framework’s planned introduction in October 2027, after years of legislative development.

articles.title: Robinhood unveils an AI that trades your money 24/7, and you carry all the risk
articles.snippet: Robinhood users could soon get an AI agent that trades on their behalf, even at 2 a.m. But if a trade goes wrong, users' bear the risk, not Robinhood.

articles.title: Bitcoin rally shows signs of cooling even as a 'bull score' gauge nears its perfect score
articles.snippet: A trend guage tracked on onchain analysis firm CryptoQuant is near its ceiling. The buyers who drove BTC to an eight-month high are already pulling back.

articles.title: Ethereum users get another way to pay privately as zk.money returns after three years
articles.snippet: The relaunched wallet hides payments made on the Aztec Network, while deposits from Ethereum remain visible.
